summary: BBVA filed a 6-K announcing partial execution of a share capital reduction approved at its 20 March 2026 Ordinary General Shareholders Meeting under agenda item five. The bank cancelled 70,339,213 treasury shares of EUR0.49 par value, a nominal reduction of EUR34,466,214.37, acquired via the third and final tranche of a buyback programme first disclosed 30 April 2026 and completed 3 August 2026. Post-cancellation capital is EUR2,700,323,995.53 across 5,510,865,297 shares. The reduction is charged to unrestricted reserves under Article 335 c), so creditors have no Article 334 right of opposition. BBVA will request delisting of the redeemed shares. Watch shareholder-return cadence and any successor buyback programme, with float and earnings-per-share accretion as the key sensitivities.
